App details

Workout / Training

Follow expert-designed exercise programs and keep a record of your training.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

Training guidance for beginners, people returning to exercise and gym users, supported by a training diary and personal records. Programs and exercise demonstrations will need specialist review; the starting selection is still being prepared.

Main features

  • Exercise demonstrations and equipment guidance.
  • Record sets, repetitions, weight and duration.
  • Rest timer, training history and personal records.
  • Use downloaded training modules offline.

This app is planned. The description presents documented plans, not an app available to download. The final design and app still need approval and testing; there is no announced release date.

How to use

Choose an expert-reviewed program module and download its content after checking the size. Follow exercise and machine demonstrations, then record sets, repetitions, weight or duration. Use the rest timer and review completed sessions, personal records and program progress. Delete downloaded content separately from the purchase entitlement if you need storage.

Important limits

The starting programs and free baseline still need expert input and validation. It is a fitness aid, not diagnosis or injury treatment. There is no automatic exercise substitution, camera movement grading or self-built program editor.

Offline use, permissions and purchases

The planned core functions run on the device without a JN86 account. Advertising, purchases, optional downloads and external links may need an internet connection. Offline core operation does not rule out separate service data flows.

Android 7.0 or newer is the common planned baseline. Individual sensor and platform features still depend on the device.

Permissions

Core logging does not require camera, microphone or location. Optional reminders use notification permission. Module download, purchase and restore can need internet.

Local data

Workout records, weights, notes and progress would be local-first data. Content downloads and Play purchases have separate service data flows. No mandatory account, advertising SDK or social feed is planned.

Advertising and purchases

The plan is entirely ad-free: free baseline material plus separately purchased expert modules, each bought once. Download and purchase or restore may require internet; installed content works offline. The starting content still needs expert validation.

First version and later ideas

The functions above belong to the documented plan for the first version. Features mentioned below as excluded or later ideas are not promised as current capabilities.

Expert modules, diary and offline downloaded content are planned. AI coaching, rehabilitation without approval, social rankings and subscriptions are excluded.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
